Title: A customer's Participants and Contracts lists open from the Customers list
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers.
Step Expected: The Customers list opens.

Step Action: Check the row has the link of the row.
Step Expected: The link is shown.

Step Action: Click the link of the row.
Step Expected: The page starts to open.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Step Expected: The page loads without a server error.

Step Action: Check the page heading.
Step Expected: The heading is the one of the row.

Title: The customer pages link to each other
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers.
Step Expected: The Customers list opens.

Step Action: Click Participants on the first customer.
Step Expected: The Participants page opens.

Step Action: Check the buttons on the page.
Step Expected: The button of the row is shown.

Step Action: Click the button of the row.
Step Expected: The target page opens without a server error.

Step Action: Check the page heading.
Step Expected: The heading is the one of the row.

Title: Scheme History opens from the Schemes list
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes.
Step Expected: The Schemes list opens.

Step Action: Find the History column.
Step Expected: A View link is shown on each row.

Step Action: Click View on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The Scheme History page starts to open.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Step Expected: The page loads without a server error.

Step Action: Check the page heading.
Step Expected: The heading is Scheme History.

Title: Invoice Generation shows its Generate Invoices button for an admin with the role
Step Action: Open System Administration > Manage Roles and tick Generate Invoices for yourself.
Step Expected: The role is saved.

Step Action: Open Home and Manage Contracts.
Step Expected: The menu lists Invoice Generation.

Step Action: Click Invoice Generation.
Step Expected: The Invoice Generation page opens.

Step Action: Check the buttons on the page.
Step Expected: A Generate Invoices button is shown.

Step Action: Do not click Generate Invoices; untick the role again.
Step Expected: The role is removed.

Title: A new customer with every required field is saved
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers > Create Customer.
Step Expected: The empty Create Customer form opens.

Step Action: Fill the required fields with synthetic values and choose a Customer Type and both Countries.
Step Expected: The fields show the values.

Step Action: Click Save.
Step Expected: An alert says Customer details saved successfully.

Step Action: Check the buttons after the save.
Step Expected: Go to Participants Page and Go to Contracts Page appear.

Step Action: Untick Active and Save again.
Step Expected: The test customer is set inactive.

Title: Printing a group address label is answered by the page
Step Action: Open Distributions > Group Address Labels.
Step Expected: The list of group addresses opens.

Step Action: Check the Print column.
Step Expected: A Print link is shown on each row.

Step Action: Click Print on the first row.
Step Expected: The page reloads.

Step Action: Read the message above the list.
Step Expected: It says Label sent to Printer or Error Printing Label.

Step Action: Check the page after the print.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
